description: FREE, no key: the Taifoon venue's last fills for one market (newest first, up to 500): each with side, price, qty, whether the taker was the maker, and t_logical; plus the flow over them computed here: fills, taker buy qty, taker sell qty, the window in seconds, VWAP. Venue flow (synthetic makers and flow actors), never CME order flow: say 'venue book'. Attributions are the venue's anonymised ids; no person is named.

market.description: a tape market (NQ, ES, YM, BTC, ETH, SOL, ICP) or any book the venue serves: its twin markets and spot books (GET https://api.taifoon.dev/book/v1/markets) and its futures contracts, micros included (GET https://api.taifoon.dev/book/v1/futures/contracts)

name: book_fills
